dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Alright kid, time to remember your BASICS! You choose up to {{red-bold}}three Actions{{/red-bold}} and commit to 'em, once they're queued, they're locked till their turn comes up. Have a go, kid. Choose anyone!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Heavy Slice is your default attack — use it often, especially when I'm blocking. The clash of swords rises our Battle Spirit!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Brace yourself, kid! My first move this turn is {{red-bold}}Flame Strike{{/red-bold}}, feel the heat! Hahahaha!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: That Battōjutsu I sheathed last round built up my {{red-bold}}Blaze Slash{{/red-bold}}, it's landing as my 3rd action this round! You better queue Uke as your 2nd action, it'll come out faster!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Well done! Fight on till the next!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Still stalling, kid? You can't stay curled up by that fire back home your whole life. The Samurai Lands won't wait for you!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: I know, I know, you miss home already. But a Fox who never leaves the den never grows a tail worth telling stories about!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Hahahaha! Look at you, dragging your paws like you'd rather be back for dinner. Queue up, kid!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: No one's walking through that door to save you this time. Out here, you grow up fast, or not at all.

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: You're still here? Half the pups in the Samurai Lands would've queued three Actions by now, kid.

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Hahahaha! Homesick already? We're only getting started, Fox!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Keep stalling and I'll start charging you rent for standing in my field.

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Alright, kid, enough moping. Show me you're ready to leave the den for real!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: That's it. You asked for it!

dialog.speaker: SAMURAI TEACHER
dialog.text: Alright kid, it's time for the last lesson here. Watch my Aura, you can predict what's to come.
